data.name: ToolWindowRegion
data.comment: What a screen reader is told as Next Region enters a tool window, or one is opened from its edge tab; {window} is its name.

data.name: ToolWindowOver
data.comment: What a screen reader is told as a tool window opens over the editors from its edge tab.

data.name: ToolWindowHidden
data.comment: What a screen reader is told as a tool window opened from its edge tab is put away.

data.name: EditorRegion
data.comment: What a screen reader is told as Next Region enters the editors; {file} is the file shown.

data.name: ToolbarRegion
data.comment: What a screen reader is told as Next Region enters the toolbar.

data.name: StatusBarRegion
data.comment: What a screen reader is told as Next Region enters the status bar.

data.name: SearchRules
data.value: Search rules by name or id
data.comment: Run Inspection by Name's search field.

data.name: ReadingRules
data.comment: Run Inspection by Name while it reads the rules the C# language server's analyzers have.
